chat.say: Idhar bed se paani lene nahi utha jaata.

data.asar: Bina ruke safar karna seekho is nanhe superhero se
data.caption:
150 gram ka nanha parinda bana real-life superhero! 🦅✨

• Manipur se Africa tak 5,700 km ka lamba safar tay kiya.
• Arab Sagar ke upar bina ruke lagatar 101 ghante udaan bhari.
• Is Amur Falcon parinde ka naam 'Alang' hai aur wajan sirf 150 gram hai.

Idhar hum 100 meter chalne ke liye bhi activa dhoondhte hain! 😂

Apne us aalsi dost ko tag karo jo bistar se paani lene bhi nahi uthta! 👇
